steps.heading: The 3D viewport
steps.text: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom, click a feature for its details. Parts are coloured; cut and intersect tool volumes render translucent so you can see what they removed.

steps.heading: Edit by prompt
steps.text: Describe a change in plain English and an LLM proposes a rewrite of the design recipe — not a guess at the mesh, the actual parametric feature tree.

steps.heading: Review, then commit
steps.text: A proposal renders here for you to read before anything happens: apply in place to edit this design with no new version, or save as a new version and keep the original untouched.

steps.heading: Ask, don't change
steps.text: A read-only thread for questions about the model — is the hub connected to the rim, why isn't this functional. Nothing asked here is ever applied.
